decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the average computed from the plotted data: the mean of the 5 series in each period
the average drawn as a reference series, solid, in the average's dark grey, labelled at its end in bold (D-21 (c), G7.16)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, North slot 2, Central slot 3, South slot 4, West slot 5
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: Central moved 0.41 line heights, Average moved 0.41 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
reference series in the reserved dark grey, labelled in bold: Average
the unit phrase on the top label: “$500K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$500K in donations”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)

source.shows: the static chart the book puts in place of an animation: every region and the average at once; the average computed from the five regions (the book's drawn average is not their mean, D-54) and drawn solid in the reserved dark grey, its label bold (D-21 (c), R14-3)
